bead.title: Implement HybridProjectionStore core
bead.description: Implement HybridProjectionStore, preferably exported from pqueue-sqlite. It wraps SqliteProjectionStore plus InMemoryProjection. ensure_shard must create/validate SQLite, hydrate memory from SqliteProjectionStore::export_projection_image before returning SQLite high-water, and fail closed if hydration cannot establish parity. apply must write the full batch to SQLite first and then to memory. If SQLite succeeds but memory apply fails, set a poisoned state so subsequent reads, validations, and writes return storage errors until restart. All hot reads and pre-commit validation delegate to memory after hydration. Add parity helpers/tests comparing memory and SQLite after apply and recovery. Out of scope: PQUEUE_PROJECTION_BACKEND env parsing and Helm.

1. cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_projection -- --nocapture passes.

3. cargo test -p pqueue-projection passes.
4. cargo fmt --check passes.
